title: Global Administrators are added as local administrators on joined devices

messages.businessImpact: Every Global Administrator holds local administrator rights on every joined device. A single account compromise becomes administrative access to the entire estate rather than to the tenant alone.
remediation: Turn off the setting that adds Global Administrator to the local administrators group.
Use the Device Administrator role for the small number of people who genuinely need it, or Endpoint Privilege Management for elevation on demand.
messages.cannotSee: Whether the global administrators on this tenant should be local administrators on every joined device is a judgement. What is visible is only that the setting is on; who holds the role, and how many of them there are, is ACC-001's question.
